    Morphisms with vector-space coefficients #

    Let u : X ⟶ Y be a morphism of Kronecker modules such that every morphism X ⟶ Y is a scalar multiple of u, and u is nonzero on some vector of V. For a vector space N, a pair of linear maps V_X → N ⊗ V_Y, W_X → N ⊗ W_Y commuting with a and b (a morphism X ⟶ N ⊗ Y) has the form ν ⊗ u for a vector ν ∈ N (Bricks.coeff_eq). Coordinates in a basis of N are morphisms X ⟶ Y, hence scalar multiples of u, and only finitely many are nonzero. This is the coefficient condition (S3) of Göbel–Simson for the rigid gluing families.
